description: This file defines the class 'testPlanUrgency' which extends 'testplan' to provide functionality for managing and retrieving urgency levels for test cases within a test planning system. It includes methods for setting test urgency, setting urgency for test suites, and retrieving urgency and priority data for test plans.

classes.name: testPlanUrgency
classes.description: Extends the testplan class to add methods for managing test case urgency and priority within test plans, including setting urgency levels for individual test cases and test suites, and retrieving urgency data and calculated priorities for test plans.

methods.name: setTestUrgency
methods.description: Sets the urgency level for a specific test case version within a test plan by executing an UPDATE SQL statement on the database.

methods.name: setSuiteUrgency
methods.description: Sets the urgency level for all test cases directly under a specific test suite within a test plan using a SQL UPDATE with a subquery.

methods.name: getSuiteUrgency
methods.description: Retrieves urgency information for test cases within a specified test suite of a test plan, filtering by platform and other criteria, and returning detailed information.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Calculates and returns the priority of test plan test cases based on urgency and importance, with options for detailed views.
